references.text: Here we see an example of a similar promise given by a king, where King Solomon promises to give the Queen of Sheba whatever she asks for, which mirrors Herod's promise to give John the Baptist's daughter whatever she requests.
This verse reflects the idea of giving someone what they ask for, even if it is half the kingdom, an expression used to show willingness to give away great wealth or power.
The book of Esther contains a similar situation where King Ahasuerus offers Queen Esther up to half his kingdom, which mirrors the promise given in Mark 6:23.
